entries.en: to reprimand, to reproach, to censure

entries.zh: 責罵；數落（承前條 reprehender 之義）
entries.en: to reprimand, to scold
entries.notes: H欄「加張」詞義不明，係依L欄 reprehender 續條推定。

entries.en: to resent; to find fault with; to reproach
entries.notes: L欄作「reprehender, venir」，第二詞與H/M欄「嫌」不合，疑原文誤書，存疑。

entries.zh: 初時遭人指摘，日後方見其用（原注以橄欖為喻）
entries.en: to be faulted at first though later found useful (likened to the olive)
entries.notes: L欄中段殘損（sa ueala[残]），語意據「aunq después aprovechada, como esta fruta」推定。

entries.zh: 斥責並極言其過，以促其改過
entries.en: to reprove, pressing the fault home so that the offender reforms
entries.notes: H欄「訐奸摘伏」字形有疑，M欄音寫難對讀，義從L欄。

entries.zh: 諫諍；規勸上位者之過失
entries.en: to remonstrate with a superior over a fault
entries.notes: H欄作「口諫」，當即從口之「諫」；M欄 ciu 一音未詳。

entries.en: a weir, a dam; a pond formed by damming water
entries.notes: H欄「陂」義合於L欄，M欄 quēg 與陂之常讀不合。

entries.en: to build a dam or embankment; damming
entries.notes: M欄 chôc 與「築」常讀不合，義據H欄字義定。

entries.en: wharf, dock, landing place
entries.notes: H欄「埠頭」與L欄 represa del agua（水堰）語義不合，M欄 be iàu 疑為 bé-thâu（碼頭）之音寫，未能定奪。

entries.en: to govern as regent; to hold or manage an office
entries.notes: H欄空白，M欄漫漶難讀，僅據L欄 regentar 立義。

entries.en: to repress, to suppress, to hold down
to check, to stop, to restrain
entries.notes: M欄作 ax（[疑:at/ax]），對應「遏」at 之讀。

entries.en: to restrain and keep someone from doing harm
to repress by force; to coerce

entries.zh: 在上位者面前克制隱忍（H欄「抱服」有疑，或兼含屈服之意）
entries.en: to restrain oneself in the presence of a superior
entries.notes: H欄「抱服」字形有疑，M欄 cu hog 對應不明，義從L欄。

entries.en: to judge as failing; to condemn
entries.notes: H欄「汞」與L欄 reprobar/juzgar 不合，M欄 froān 疑為「判」之音寫，未能定奪。

entries.zh: 貼出（榜示）；將落第者公開貼出
entries.en: to post up (a failed candidate's name); to publish by posting
entries.notes: 「貼出來」與「使落第」之關聯係依L欄 examinado 之考試語境推定。

entries.en: to repudiate or divorce one's wife
entries.notes: L欄 reputar 於此當即 repudiar（休妻），與H欄「休」、M欄 hiú lý（休離）相合。

entries.en: to divorce; to separate from one's wife
a bill of divorce; a letter of repudiation
